datasets.summary: Located an author selected-gene table (PMC6437596 Supplemental Table 2, 196 genes, DESeq2 'STAT3KO vs. Control' log2 effects plus unlabelled P). manualReview.note_append: 2026-11-15 turbo notloc1: Europe PMC OA supplement mmc1.xlsx (SHA-256 93ca2691...) datasets.summary: New source: Europe PMC full-text search links GSE252364 to bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/2024.01.04.574014 (not linked by GEO). Its Supplemental Data 4 holds complete SCN per-timepoint DESeq2 MCD-vs-CTL tables (56,884 rows/sheet). On the CT00 sheet vs the registered CT0 edgeR-QL output: 15,440 pairs (98.2% of registered rows), Pearson 0.663, Spearman 0.921, direction 93.05%. manualReview.note_append: 2026-11-15 turbo notloc1: Europe PMC full-text search links GSE252364 to bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/2024.01.04.574014 (Saer et al. 2024; not linked by GEO). Supplemental Data 4 (SHA-256 recorded in SOURCES.tsv) gives SCN per-timepoint DESeq2 MCD-vs-CTL tables. On CT00 versus the registered CT0 3-v-3 edgeR-QL output: 15,440 symbol pairs (98.2% of registered rows; 297 duplicated author symbols excluded), Pearson 0.663, Spearman 0.921, nonzero direction 93.05%, median absolute log2FC difference 0.018. Extreme unshrunk author values (e.g. Sftpc -22) depress Pearson. Author q<0.05 has 39 paired genes (94.9% direction-concordant); registered FDR<0.05 has 3 genes, all shared. Gstm3 (author -2.33, registered +10.47) and Rab43 magnitude conflicts remain for review. The preprint methods were not readable (bioRxiv Cloudflare 1015), so the author model and CT00 membership are unconfirmed. Evidence: continued-sources/GSE252364/turbo-2026-11-15-notloc1/.
